svg.title: Figure 3-13. SW FMEA detection evidence
svg.desc: SW FMEA (SWF rev 1.15): 149 causes by the evidence behind their detection rating: proven 43, targeted 16, generic 22, not run 1, hardware 8, none 59. One row per element, and the 41 cited test files with how CI treats each (1 not run in CI).

panda suite engaged_mismatch, run by safety.yaml
panda suite heartbeat_monitor, run by safety.yaml
panda suite heartbeat_siren, run by safety.yaml
panda suite reference_lock, run by safety.yaml

Each square is one cause, coloured by its strongest cited test (detection_controls[].test) and its D rating; hover for the cause and its tests. How CI treats a file is worked out from the repository, not from the analysis text:

unit tests need a unittest TestCase that tools/test_runner.py collects; COMMA_HARDWARE_TEST or a device skip means hardware only; panda suites count when safety.yaml runs them; opendbc safety tests and files named in a workflow count as CI.
Green means the D rating claims proof, not that this figure checked the proof. A test run in CI says nothing about whether it would fail on the fault.
